title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: Oct 14, 2026 10:54 AM PHT
Sara Duterte’s defense team may seek dismissal of remaining impeachment article – lawyer

Constitutional lawyer and law professor Lulu Reyes says the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte may make a major move before the impeachment trial resumes on November 9, potentially seeking a mistrial or filing a demurrer to evidence.
The possible moves could challenge the prosecution’s reliance on financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera’s findings, which the defense claims are based on false assumptions.

blocks.text: Oct 14, 2026 10:00 AM PHT
Rappler Recap: Impeachment court lifts sub judice rule on withdrawn charges vs Sara Duterte

The Senate impeachment court temporarily lifts the sub judice rule on three impeachment articles withdrawn by the prosecution against Vice President Sara Duterte, covering alleged misuse of confidential funds, bribery, and grave threats.
Rappler multimedia reporter Sundy Locus reports on the defense’s objections, the court’s ruling, and the revised November trial schedule.

blocks.text: Oct 14, 2026 9:00 AM PHT
Rappler Recap: Prosecution drops 3 of 4 impeachment articles vs Sara Duterte
The prosecution withdraws three of the four impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte, leaving unexplained wealth as the sole remaining charge.
Rappler multimedia reporter Dwight de Leon recaps and speaks with lead prosecutor Terry Ridon about the decision, the defense’s response, and the prosecution’s confidence in its remaining case.

Oct 13, 2026 6:05 PM PHT
Impeachment court lifts sub judice rule on withdrawn charges vs Sara Duterte

The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday, October 13, lifted the sub judice rule on three withdrawn impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte, allowing the parties to publicly discuss the dropped charges.
The decision drew objections from lead defense counsel Sheila Sison, who warned that abandoning Rule 18 midway through the trial could undermine the integrity of the proceedings.
Oct 13, 2026 6:03 PM PHT
Prosecution drops all cases vs Sara Duterte except unexplained wealth
“The prosecution believes it has presented sufficient evidence for Article 2 to stand on its own. We are all in here,” lead prosecutor Jinky Luistro says.
Oct 13, 2026 4:33 PM PHT
Luistro moves to strike Sison’s ‘persecution’ quip from record

Lead prosecutor Jinky Luistro asks the Senate impeachment court to strike the word “persecution,” which Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense lawyer Shiela Sison used three times during her manifestation, from the transcript of the proceedings. Luistro says the remark is unfair to the volunteer lawyers helping the prosecution present its case.
